description: Inbound calls logged in HubSpot (from RingCX) per deal owner in the chosen date range. Used for calls taken and close rate (policies sold ÷ inbound calls).

args.sql: SELECT hubspot_owner_id, COUNT(*) FROM CALL WHERE hs_call_direction = 'INBOUND' AND hs_timestamp >= {{q_from}} AND hs_timestamp <= {{q_to}} GROUP BY hubspot_owner_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 200

title: Custom-range inbound calls
